name: editor
title: Editor
description: SUI component: editor. Includes its local dependencies and SUI styles.

[data-glass=\"true\"][data-glass-state].--glass-initial-edge-color:
color-mix(
    in srgb,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 12%, white) 28%,
    transparent
  )
[data-glass=\"true\"][data-glass-state].text-shadow:
0 0 0.2em color-mix(in srgb, var(--glass-halo) 90%, transparent),
    0 0 0.5em color-mix(in srgb, var(--glass-halo) 70%, transparent),
    0 0 1em color-mix(in srgb, var(--glass-halo) 50%, transparent)

docs: The Editor uses locally bundled Monaco Workers and requires a Vite-compatible ?worker loader. Keep the installed worker.d.ts in your TypeScript include paths.
